evidence_timeline.summary: We report observations of 14 transients using the Shane Kast spectrograph at the Lick observatory on the nights of 2025-01-23 and 2025-01-24. New classifications were found for 10 objects, which includes 1 infant SN II, 2 SLSN-I, 6 SN Ia and 1 SN Ia-CSM.

evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS25awc (AT2025adj) in galaxy KUG 1458+516 at magnitude m_o = 17.25 +/- 0.04. At a distance of 48 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 60699.61 (2025-01-24.61) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.22 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60697.53. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
